harnessChangelog.1.3.0: mutate.mjs only; RQ1 to RQ3 figures from 1.2.0 are unaffected. Patches the source at the matched offset instead of by string content (a string replace always hit the first identical construct); judges detection at witness level as well as edge level; retargets CHANGE_NAV_TARGET to a declared route; excludes guard mutants on screens no edge enters; seeded stratified sampling with a fixed quota per operator; reports detection per operator with n.
harnessChangelog.1.2.0: route parser corrections, tier-aware witness check, per-construct conversion.

extractor.note: GitHub HEAD at capture time. The working copy is ahead; re-run and re-tag after pushing.
extractor.buildPatch: package.json exports point at ./src in the workspace, so a built dist/cli.js cannot resolve sibling packages. The runner rewrites exports/bin/main to ./dist before building. Fix upstream with publishConfig or conditional exports.
